Dave the Diver is a simple game about fishing and running a restaurant.

At least, until you get further in the story. Greenpeace-style eco-terrorists, alien creatures, absurd celebrities... yet somehow, it all remains a cohesive whole.

Dave the Diver is a unique experience everyone should try.

If you enjoy the Metroidvania genre, if you want to play a game that makes you smile because of its character development (Egbert, for example), or if you simply want to play something that warms your soul with good vibes, this game is for you.
Don't hesitate to buy it. Kyle Thompson absolutely deserves our support.

I very rarely use the word 'perfection' when describing my opinion on a game.
But this is 1000% deserving of that word. It feels like the PEAK of game design.

Visuals are outrageously gorgeous.
Soundtrack is heavenly.
Characters are awesome, memorable and unique in the best way.
Story was surprisingly emotional. 

I expected it to have a predictable ending, and yet it still threw a curveball and got me misty-eyed.

The first game was amazing too, but this... this is art. 
God, this franchise is just a must-play for everyone.

I can write a paper about these Wolfenstein games but gonna keep it short this time. What a lovely work of art this one is. I mean look at this game mayn. Old school, classic game mechanics, health packs and stuff. Dual wielding almost every weapon. Killing crazy Nazis... and stealth is optional.

There is a story but I'm not gonna explain it here. As a summary, you are William Joseph "B.J." Blazkowicz and you kill Nazis.

 Review 
Great game, play it.

 Final Remarks 

    • If you can, you should also check "The New Order". 
    • Shoutout to MachineGames for these Wolfenstein games.

Nice and simple puzzle adventure game with an interesting premise and artistic and stunning visuals. While very pretty to look at, it is not very engaging to play. Most of the puzzles are trivial, and the solution is immediately obvious, but the puzzle design is time-based, meaning you are required to do precise actions in a particular order during tight time windows. This, coupled together with very clunky controls, quickly becomes frustrating, and I would only really recommend this game to people looking for a mere cinematic experience.

After playin Titanfall 2, Ive been wantin another game with wall-running and fast takedowns. I didnt expect it to feel this good. The mobility’s insane, and nailing clean moves once you master it gives a huge adrenaline rush. But it has a steep learning curve n most late levels need tons of retries. my friends also said it causes rly bad 3d motion sickness, so anyone sensitive to that should think twice before buyin.

By far the best Alien game ever made, and among one of the best horror games ever made. I can't do horror but forced myself to play due to my love of the Alien franchise. No other game nails atmosphere quite like this, alongside the tension and the AI of the alien actually getting inside your head. 

If you have even the slightest interest in the Alien franchise and/or horror games, just buy it. Even worth it at full price.

I tried to play it, the style, the setting, it's what I love. Unfortunately the 'can't move' bug got to me in the first day. And that's it, I cant move, I cant play the game because of the bug that exists since release, that people complained about since release.

For those wondering. You do NOT need to buy the Deluxe edition to get the original dlc ( shivering isle, knights of the nine etc). Despite the borderline false advertisement shown above, the standard edition includes all the OG dlc including the original horse armour.

Despite this BS practice, the game itself is very well done. There are issues, crashes UI flaws such as the alchemy UI which i think is dumb. I do recommend it but I would wait a week or 2 for them to fix the major crashes. I mean its a 20 year old game, whats 2 more weeks.

Genuinely the best first experience you could ever hope to have with a game.
Story is incredibly captivating, characters are fully fleshed out, and the world wastes no time in immersing you the moment you step foot into it.
RDR2 is one of those games where you can clearly see the time and effort spent by the developers, with historically accurate assets, environments, animals, clothing, you name it. Even outside of the main story leaves zero gaps in its gameplay with hundreds of well developed side missions and achievements to work on. you could easily spend hundreds of hours playing and still find new things to discover. 10/10 game.
Played this with my two besties and it was chaotic fun! So much laughter and stress, definitely recommend it to those looking for a funny and entertaining game.

A fun game solo or with friends. Story is average imo but it feels that you don't really play raft only for the story. I enjoyed building and expanding my raft, exploring the various islands and doing dumb things. It is nice that, unlike other games, what you build is actually useful to you and always used because the raft is everything. So any time you spend building and decorating your raft does not feel wasteful or redundant. One thing to keep in mind that over a certain number of friends early game-play is hard. I recommend giving it a shot if you like survival and building games.

It's a pity that Steam doesn't allow players to give neutral review. The athmosphere is cool with all the sounds, visuals and surroundings - you're a sadist who kills sadists. Actually, enjoyed it anyway so worth giving it a try.

As much as I love the Dishonored games, I felt this one fell short somewhat. Although the voice acting and cinematics were great, the story was a bit weak and the graphics weren't up to scratch. There were some cool new powers included and interesting new characters but it was waaay too short for my liking and just felt rushed.

If you're a die hard Dishonored fan then I'd probably go for it - but I guess the reason I was disappointed was that I am such a fan and felt let down by this installment, which is why I'm not recommending it, I'm sorry to say.

Honestly, I love the doom series bought and beat them all. I was super hyped for this since they said they were focusing on bringing us an epic single player since they did not do any multiplayer.

But if that's true why did I beat a $70 game in 13.3 hours when I literally cleared all levels and played on the 2nd most difficult setting?

Also the music never really seems to have that drop the past Doom games have had, its weird it like sort of builds up but never really comes out full force?

So ask yourself is 13 hours of game play worth $70? To me it is not, I'd expect at least 25-30 hours just based on no multiplayer.

Although some of the visuals and atmosphere are pretty solid, I can't recommend this. It's extremely short, the game play is simplistic and shallow, the environments start to get boring after a while, and there's not much happening from a narrative standpoint. It's also extremely buggy at the moment, with over 4 soft locks happening to me in one hour.

I've found that while playing this game, openly narrated to myself and my peers. While not the goal it was a very educational experience alongside the thrilling gameplay. Each time I reached for an object I found myself smiling in glee at the new discovery and chance to locate myself with. Helen Keller Simulator is amazing in the way it made me appreciate the small things such as sitting on the couch or grabbing grass. Even after just 10 minutes of gameplay my outlook was altered significantly and I felt more positive 

Thanks dev and the art team!

if you like to ragdoll helpless scientists around for 10 minutes and do some fairly hard brain puzzles then this is your game. I never get tired of scaring the absolute dog out of these scientists. My only complaint is the game's length, it took me roughly 7 hours to FULLY complete it, 100% on achievements, and beat every optional room etc.

I am an old gamer, 48, and i played everything that that was significant to play, and i think the devs here made a masterpiece. The graphics, the combat, the story, atmosphere, and i cant decide which is better, thank god, for games like this. I recommend that you buy this even if you dont like action adventures.
